test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
concept: Rural and Urban Transformations, Government Policies and Schemes
question: At the time of launch of the Smart Cities Mission, how many cities were proposed to be covered under this scheme?
solution:
The Correct answer is **__100__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** 100 cities **are included under the Smart Cities Mission which was launched in the year **2015.**__
 
• Smart Cities Mission or Smart City Mission is an **urban renewal and retrofitting program** by the **Government of India with the mission to develop 100 smart cities** across the country making them citizen-friendly and sustainable.
 
• The total number of 100 smart cities have been distributed among the **States and UTs on the basis of equitable criteria**.
 
• The formula gives **equal weightage (50:50) to the urban population of the State/UT and the number of statutory towns in the State/UT.**
 
• The** Union Ministry of Urban Development is responsible **for implementing the mission in collaboration with the state governments of the respective cities.
 
• Cities will be selected based on the Smart Cities Challenge, where cities will compete in a countrywide competition to obtain the benefits from this mission.
 
• Each city will create a **Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV), headed by a full-time CEO, to implement the Smart Cities Mission.​**
